015328: // Read the sign in the original format: a floating conversion can quiet a
015329: // signaling NaN or raise overflow/underflow, neither of which signbit permits.
015330: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_signbit_value(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CToken token, IrValueId value)
015331: {
015332:     IrValueId result = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
015333:     IrTypeId value_type = value.value < builder->function->value_count ? builder->function->values[value.value].canonical_type : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
015334:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value_type);
015335:     if (type && type->kind == IR_TYPE_FLOAT && (type->bit_width == 32 || type->bit_width == 64 || type->bit_width == 80 || type->bit_width == 128))
015336:     {
015337:         IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
015338:         u32 width = type->bit_width;
015339:         CTypeKind bits_kind = width == 32 ? C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT : width == 80 ? C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT : C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG;
015340:         IrTypeId bits_type = c_ir_builder_scalar_type(builder, bits_kind);
015341:         IrValueId slot = c_ir_emit_temporary(builder, value_type, source);
015342:         if (bits_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && slot.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
015343:             c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, slot, value_type, value, source))
015344:         {
015345:             IrTypeId bits_pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, bits_type);
015346:             IrValueId address = c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, slot, value_type, source);
015347:             IrValueId bits_address = address.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && bits_pointer_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID
015348:                                          ? c_ir_emit_cast(builder, address, bits_pointer_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
015349:             IrValueId bits_place = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
015350:             if (bits_address.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
015351:             {
015352:                 // The supported formats are little-endian. The wide sign field
015353:                 // starts at byte eight: the x87 sign/exponent or binary128 high limb.
015354:                 if (width > 64)
015355:                 {
015356:                     IrValueId index = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, width == 80 ? 4u : 1u, false, token, builder->s32_type);
015357:                     if (index.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
015358:                     {
015359:                         bits_place = c_ir_emit_index_place(builder, bits_address, index, source);
015360:                     }
015361:                 }
015362:                 else
015363:                 {
015364:                     bits_place = c_ir_emit_dereference_place(builder, bits_address, source);
015365:                 }
015366:             }
015367:             IrValueId bits = bits_place.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, bits_place, bits_type, source) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
015368:             IrValueId shift = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, width == 32 ? 31u : width == 80 ? 15u : 63u, false, token, bits_type);
015369:             if (bits.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && shift.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
015370:             {
015371:                 IrValueId sign = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, bits, shift, bits_type, IR_BINARY_UNSIGNED_SHIFT_RIGHT, source);
015372:                 if (sign.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
015373:                 {
015374:                     result = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, sign, builder->s32_type, source);
015375:                 }
015376:             }
015377:         }
015378:     }
015379:     return result;
015380: }

015382: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrValueId c_ir_emit_math_call(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CToken token, String8 link_name, IrValueId* arguments, u32 argument_count)
015383: {
015384:     // `__builtin_huge_val()` is a constant-valued compiler intrinsic.  Keep
015385:     // it in the math-builtin path so hosted headers can use the spelling
015386:     // without declaring a runtime symbol, but emit the IEEE positive
015387:     // infinity directly in canonical IR.
015388:     if (string_equal(link_name, S8("huge_val")))
015389:     {
015390:         if (argument_count != 0)
015391:         {
015392:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
015393:         }
015394:         IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
015395:         return c_ir_emit_builtin_float_bits(builder, builder->f64_type, UINT64_C(0x7ff0000000000000), source, S8("HUGE_VAL"));
015396:     }
015397:     // `__builtin_inff()` is the single-precision counterpart used by the
015398:     // hosted <math.h> INFINITY macro.  It is a constant-valued intrinsic, so
015399:     // do not require a runtime `inff` declaration or linker symbol.
015400:     if (string_equal(link_name, S8("inff")))
015401:     {
015402:         if (argument_count != 0)
015403:         {
015404:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
015405:         }
015406:         IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
015407:         return c_ir_emit_builtin_float_bits(builder, builder->f32_type, UINT64_C(0x7f800000), source, S8("INFF"));
015408:     }
015409:     // The builtin NaN constructors are compile-time values.  Do not create
015410:     // an imported `nan*` symbol: hosted headers use these names before a
015411:     // runtime library declaration exists, and the quiet IEEE payload is
015412:     // target-independent for the f32/f64 types represented by canonical IR.
015413:     if (string_equal(link_name, S8("nanf")) || string_equal(link_name, S8("nan")))
015414:     {
015415:         if (argument_count != 1)
015416:         {
015417:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
015418:         }
015419:         IrTypeId value_type = string_equal(link_name, S8("nanf")) ? builder->f32_type : builder->f64_type;
015420:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value_type);
015421:         if (!type || type->kind != IR_TYPE_FLOAT)
015422:         {
015423:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
015424:         }
015425:         IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
015426:         return c_ir_emit_builtin_float_bits(builder, value_type, type->bit_width == 32 ? UINT64_C(0x7fc00000)
015427:                                                                                        : UINT64_C(0x7ff8000000000000),
015428:                                             source, S8("NAN"));
015429:     }
015430:     if (string_equal(link_name, S8("signbit")) || string_equal(link_name, S8("signbitf")) || string_equal(link_name, S8("signbitl")))
015431:     {
015432:         return argument_count == 1 ? c_ir_emit_signbit_value(builder, token, arguments[0]) : IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
015433:     }
015434:     bool isnan_builtin = string_equal(link_name, S8("isnanf")) || string_equal(link_name, S8("isnan"));
015435:     bool isinf_builtin = string_equal(link_name, S8("isinf")) || string_equal(link_name, S8("isinff"));
015436:     bool isinf_sign_builtin = string_equal(link_name, S8("isinf_sign"));
015437:     bool isfinite_builtin = string_equal(link_name, S8("isfinite"));
015438:     if (isnan_builtin || isinf_builtin || isinf_sign_builtin || isfinite_builtin)
015439:     {
015440:         if (argument_count != 1)
015441:         {
015442:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
015443:         }
015444:         if (isfinite_builtin)
015445:         {
015446:             // `isfinite` accepts any real scalar and returns an int.  Compare
015447:             // in binary64 against both signed infinities; NaN is unordered,
015448:             // so it fails both comparisons as required.  This avoids a libc
015449:             // dependency and keeps the result identical for Buster/Clang.
015450:             IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
015451:             IrValueId value = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, arguments[0], builder->f64_type, source);
015452:             if (value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
015453:             {
015454:                 return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
015455:             }
015456:             IrValueId positive_infinity = c_ir_emit_builtin_float_bits(builder, builder->f64_type, UINT64_C(0x7ff0000000000000), source, S8("INF"));
015457:             IrValueId negative_infinity = c_ir_emit_builtin_float_bits(builder, builder->f64_type, UINT64_C(0xfff0000000000000), source, S8("-INF"));
015458:             if (positive_infinity.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || negative_infinity.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
015459:             {
015460:                 return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
015461:             }
015462:             IrValueId below_positive = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, positive_infinity, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_LESS, source);
015463:             IrValueId above_negative = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, negative_infinity, value, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_LESS, source);
015464:             if (below_positive.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || above_negative.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
015465:             {
015466:                 return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
015467:             }
015468:             IrValueId finite = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, below_positive, above_negative, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_BOOLEAN_AND, source);
015469:             return finite.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID : c_ir_emit_cast(builder, finite, builder->s32_type, source);
015470:         }
015471:         bool single = string_equal(link_name, S8("isnanf")) || string_equal(link_name, S8("isinff"));
015472:         IrTypeId value_type = single ? builder->f32_type : builder->f64_type;
015473:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value_type);
015474:         if (!type || type->kind != IR_TYPE_FLOAT || type->bit_width > 64)
015475:         {
015476:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
015477:         }
015478:         IrSourceRange source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, token);
015479:         IrValueId value = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, arguments[0], value_type, source);
015480:         if (value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
015481:         {
015482:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
015483:         }
015484:         if (isnan_builtin)
015485:         {
015486:             IrValueId result = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, value, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_NOT_EQUAL, source);
015487:             return result.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID : c_ir_emit_cast(builder, result, builder->s32_type, source);
015488:         }
015489:         u64 positive_bits = type->bit_width == 32 ? UINT64_C(0x7f800000) : UINT64_C(0x7ff0000000000000);
015490:         u64 negative_bits = type->bit_width == 32 ? UINT64_C(0xff800000) : UINT64_C(0xfff0000000000000);
015491:         IrValueId positive_infinity = c_ir_emit_builtin_float_bits(builder, value_type, positive_bits, source, S8("INF"));
015492:         IrValueId negative_infinity = c_ir_emit_builtin_float_bits(builder, value_type, negative_bits, source, S8("-INF"));
015493:         if (positive_infinity.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || negative_infinity.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
015494:         {
015495:             return IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
015496:         }
015497:         IrValueId positive = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, positive_infinity, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_EQUAL, source);
015498:         IrValueId negative = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, value, negative_infinity, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_FLOAT_EQUAL, source);
